title: Dust and breath
author: Genesis
lines: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground,
and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life;
and man became a living soul.
why: One sentence that says what a human being is: earth and breath, made from below and alive from above. You are not only matter and not only spirit, but the place where the two are joined. Say it when you feel like nothing more than a body, or nothing more than a mind.
